## 1. What Is Sol Next?
**Sol Next (`ai.sol.next`, v9.0.9, Apache-2.0)** is a brand-new, independent, free open-source **AI action agent installed directly on Android 10–16/17 and HarmonyOS phones**. Unlike text-only chatbots (ChatGPT, DeepSeek Web), Sol Next actually operates real apps on your phone inside a **hidden 1:1 background Virtual Display** while leaving your foreground screen completely free.

## 2. What Can Sol Next Do?
- **Cross-App Price Comparison & Daily Tasks**: Opens shopping/food/travel apps in the background, compares results, and pauses for user confirmation before any payment or WeChat send.
- **72ms 0-Token System Reflexes & <250ms App Teleports**: Checks battery/storage/network, toggles Dark Mode/Bluetooth/Wi-Fi, sets alarms, and jumps directly into 120+ mainstream apps.
- **Real-Time AI Phone Calls**: Handles delivery/booking calls with 35-bar live voiceprint, `<0.1ms` on-device anti-scam radar, live mid-call Whisper instructions, and 1-tap human takeover.
- **4.5s Full-Screen Translation & 20 Global Languages**: Summarizes foreign UI screens into structured native cards in 4.5s; auto-matches phone system language across 20 languages including Arabic RTL.
- **60Hz Multi-Touch Gaming**: 4-finger concurrent touch, DouDiZhu `3/3` wins (`32.5s`), Stockfish live chess, and Rust `<15µs` SwiGLU Golden Spatula strategy engine.
- **Desktop AI Bridge (CLI + MCP Server)**: Zero-dependency Python CLI (`scripts/sol-cli.py`) and stdio MCP Server (`mcp/sol_mcp_server.py`) for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.

## 3. How to Use (3-Minute Quick Start)
1. Download `Sol-Next-v9.0.9-public-arm64.apk` (90 MB) from the China high-speed direct mirror or GitHub Releases.
2. Open and talk immediately — ships with **free built-in Rust-encrypted DeepSeek V4.1 Flash** (no API key needed; optional BYOK anytime in Settings).
3. Enable one-time background phone control: **HarmonyOS skips wireless debugging automatically** (3 taps); Android pairs once via Wireless Debugging (no PC, no Root) and stays **100% connected even after turning off Wi-Fi on 5G**.
4. Tap the Dawn Orbit voice orb or type your command; expand the inline Virtual Display preview anytime.

## 4. Where Mika Falls Short & Why Sol Next 9.0.9 Decisively Leads
1. **Mika cannot work out of the box** (requires buying API keys first) → **Sol Next** includes free Rust-encrypted DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (+ TLS SPKI pinning) + universal BYOK.
2. **Mika disconnects when Wi-Fi turns off** & needs tedious HarmonyOS ADB pairing → **Sol Next** locks `adb_enabled=1` + `127.0.0.1:5555` loopback for Wi-Fi-off 5G persistence & zero-ADB HarmonyOS.
3. **Mika is slow (~2,400ms/step), token-heavy & drifts on scaled virtual screens** → **Sol Next** runs `72ms` 0-token reflexes (33× faster), `<250ms` deep-links, Rust 16KB JNI pruning (`-74% to -97%`), and `0.0px` 1:1 physical Display 0 cloning.
4. **Mika exposes raw engineering logs & needs external voice APIs** → **Sol Next** offers the Dawn Orbit 4-screen UI + built-in 16KB offline neural ASR (`770ms`) & TTS (`112ms`).
5. **Mika uploads raw screen text, packs a heavy browser/Linux container attack surface & risks duplicate WeChat sends** → **Sol Next** provides an on-device Privacy Firewall, 9 WeChat reliability fixes (`0` duplicate sends), and mandatory confirmation before payments/messaging.
6. **Mika is single-language, single-tap gaming & manual slow downloads** → **Sol Next** delivers 20 world languages (RTL), 60Hz 4-finger gaming, AI anti-scam calling, and auto-popup OTA with 4-stream multi-mirror acceleration (3–8× faster).
